.. _X_11:
.. _FeuerbachPoint:

X_11
====

.. rubric:: FEUERBACH POINT

.. enunciation::

   :ref:`X_11 <X_11>` is the point of tangency of the nine-point circle and the incircle. The nine-point circle is the circumcenter of the :term:`medial triangle <medial-triangle>`, as well as the :term:`orthic triangle <orthic-triangle>`. Feuerbach's famous theorem states that the nine-point circle is tangent to the incircle and the three excircles.

.. figure:: x-00011.svg
   :alt: X_11 — FEUERBACH POINT
   :align: center

   **X_11** (*FEUERBACH POINT*) constructed on acute reference triangle :math:`(a, b, c) = (5, 6, 7)` with unit baseline :g:`AB <[ A B ]>` = :math:`1`.

.. admonition:: Constructed Elements
   :class: note

   * **Circle:** :term:`Incircle <incircle>` (:g:`incircle <incircle>`) — Inscribed circle tangent to sidelines at T_a, T_b, T_c; centered at X_1 INCENTER
   * **Circle:** :term:`Nine-Point Circle <nine-point circle>` (:g:`nine_point_circle <nine_point_circle>`) — Passes through side midpoints M_a, M_b, M_c and altitude feet H_a, H_b, H_c; centered at X_5
   * **Central Lines:** :g:`{1, 5} <{ 1, 5 }>`
   * **Related Centers:** :g:`X_1 <X_1>` (:ref:`INCENTER <X_1>`), :g:`X_5 <X_5>` (:ref:`NINE-POINT CENTER <X_5>`)

   | **Trilinears:** :math:`1 - \cos(B - C) : 1 - \cos(C - A) : 1 - \cos(A - B)`
   | **Barycentrics:** :math:`a(1 - \cos(B - C)) : b(1 - \cos(C - A)) : c(1 - \cos(A -B))`
   | **Tripolars:** :math:`\sqrt{(a-b-c) (a^{4}-2 a^{2} b^{2}+b^{4}+a^{2} b c+a b^{2} c-2 b^{3} c-2 a^{2} c^{2}+a b c^{2}+2 b^{2} c^{2}-2 b c^{3}+c^{4})} : :`

   Let :g:`L_{A} <L_A>` be the line through :g:`A <A>` parallel to :ref:`X_1 <X_1>`\ \ :ref:`X_3 <X_3>`, and define :g:`L_{B} <L_B>` and :g:`L_{C} <L_C>` cyclically. Let :g:`M_{A} <M_A>` be the reflection of :g:`BC <[ B C ]>` in :g:`L_{A} <L_A>`, and define :g:`M_{B} <M_B>` and :g:`M_{C} <M_C>` cyclically. Let :g:`A' <A'>` = :g:`M_{B} <M_B>`\ ∩\ :g:`M_{C} <M_C>`, and define cyclically :g:`B' <B'>` and :g:`C' <C'>` cyclically. The triangle :g:`A'B'C' << A' B' C' >>` is inversely similar to, and 3 times the size of, :g:`ABC << A B C >>`. Let :g:`A″B″C″ << A″ B″ C″ >>` be the reflection of :g:`A'B'C' << A' B' C' >>` in line :ref:`X_1 <X_1>`\ \ :ref:`X_3 <X_3>`. The triangle :g:`A″B″C″ << A″ B″ C″ >>` is homothetic to :g:`ABC << A B C >>`, with center of homothety :ref:`X_11 <X_11>`; see :cite:`Hyacinthos #16741 <hyacinthos>`/16782, Sep 2008. (Randy Hutson, March 25, 2016)
